profile.name: Md Tanzid Haque
profile.title: Software Developer
profile.tagline: I turn manual business processes like sales, approvals, finance and reporting into reliable software, so your team spends less time on paperwork and more on the work that grows the business.
profile.summary: Software Engineer with 4+ years of experience building production systems that automate how businesses run: ERP modules, multi-level approval workflows, payments and reporting. I focus on clean architecture, fast and reliable software, and delivery you can plan around, using AI-assisted tooling to move quickly without compromising code quality.

services.title: ERP & business systems
services.body: Sales, finance, HR and approval workflows with role-based access, audit trails and reports that stay fast at 100k+ records.

services.title: SaaS & web applications
services.body: Laravel and Next.js products from first schema to production, with queues, real-time updates and clean APIs.

services.title: E-commerce & payments
services.body: Storefronts and admin panels with SSLCommerz, bKash and Stripe, order tracking and payment reconciliation.

services.title: Performance & deployment
services.body: Query tuning, Redis caching, CI/CD pipelines, VPS and Docker deployments, and malware scanning in CI.

highlights: AIROS ERP development: built features across the Laravel API and the React/TypeScript frontend.
Sales & Distribution module: distributors, modern trade customers, orders, invoices, delivery orders, sales returns, POS and outbound shipments.
Control Center module: users, HR, master data, organization setup and system settings, all redesigned on a shared workbench UI.
Enterprise-grade Finance module: collections, cash and bank verification, credit policies, base pricing and special pricing.
Multi-level approval workflows: staged change requests that can be sent back, rejected or approved, with approval roles and substitutes.
Optimized reports: paginated, generate-on-demand reports, background Excel/CSV exports and server-side PDF documents.
Access-based data visibility: users see only the stores, zones and customers they have been granted.
Permission-based access control: module, menu and action permissions, with bulk assignment across users.
Designed and implemented scalable authentication systems using Sanctum and JWT.
Optimized complex database queries, reducing response times from 3s to 500ms.
Integrated secure payment gateways including SSLCOMMERZ and Stripe.
Built real-time systems using Laravel Reverb, Pusher, SMS, and email pipelines.
Implemented queue-based architecture with Laravel Horizon for background jobs.
Developed automated reporting systems (PDF, CSV, Excel exports).
AI automation: Whatsapp auto replay with self hosted n8n and automated product SEO generation.
Managed production infrastructure, CI/CD pipelines, and VPS deployments.
Contributed to ERP system development with modular and reusable components.
Improved frontend performance and usability for large-scale data interfaces.
Assisted in reporting and dashboard feature development.

projects.name: Lanka Express Agency Management System
projects.subtitle: Lanka Express, visa and immigration consultancy, Dhaka
highlights: Built end to end for an international visa service and consultancy firm, combining an internal CRM with the public website.
Lead-to-visa pipeline: leads, meetings and minutes, conversion to customers, and visa cases with document checklists, tasks and deadlines.
Finance module: invoices with a draft-to-paid lifecycle, payments and refunds, aging and collections reports, and race-safe invoice and receipt numbering.
Branded PDF invoices, receipts and letters (NOC, salary certificate, pay slip, appointment letter) with QR-code verification.
Role- and permission-based access control with a full audit log and configurable master data.
Section-based page builder for public pages, with server-rendered SEO tags and a sitemap.
Public site: per-visa-type landing pages, a free assessment flow and WhatsApp lead capture.
Dashboard analytics for leads, cases and finance; CI/CD deploys to Hostinger with malware scanning in CI.

projects.name: FBS
projects.subtitle: Faculty of Business Studies, University of Dhaka
highlights: FBS Website: a Laravel CMS for a university faculty, with content managed entirely from an admin panel.
Block-based page builder: a three-pane drag-and-build editor, a block registry and renderer, and record-aware blocks for detail pages.
Layout-driven detail pages for departments, programs and faculty, each overridable per record.
Admin-managed SEO and meta settings applied across all public pages.
Media library on Cloudflare R2 object storage.
Deployment pipelines: Docker deployment & CI/CD pipelines setup.
Security hardening: removed an obfuscated backdoor from the build config and added a ClamAV malware scan to CI.
Responsive public site, with test coverage for the block builder and page conversion.

projects.name: EMBA Admission
projects.subtitle: Executive MBA Admission system, Faculty of Business Studies, University of Dhaka
highlights: EMBA Admission Portal: built end to end, covering online application, payment, exam, viva, merit-based subject allocation and admission.
Grew paid applicants from 600–700 to 1,100–1,300 per intake, an increase of about 80%.
Integrated bKash payments with receipt PDFs, payment reconciliation and protection against duplicate-callback race conditions.
Automated the admission pipeline: Excel/CSV marks import, absence handling, configurable viva eligibility, capacity-based viva board assignment and seat reallocation rounds.
Built multi-channel notifications: OTP sign-up and login, templated email and SMS with bulk sending, delivery tracking and retries, and real-time Telegram alerts for admins.
Built an applicant support ticketing system with attachments, internal notes and live notification bells.
Built analytics and reporting: daily and hourly admission analytics, a drag-and-drop report builder, and Excel/CSV/PDF exports.
Built multi-batch admission cycles with per-batch accounts, bulk batch transfers and rollback, and role-based admin access with an impersonate-applicant mode.
Set up CI/CD to cPanel with GitHub Actions, scheduled queue workers, and malware scanning in CI.

projects.name: Griebs Properties
projects.subtitle: A real estate listing and management platform for Webbly Consulting Solutions.
highlights: Design and development of real estate listing and management features.
R2 Bucket integration for secure file storage.
Property data calculation and management.
Optimized database queries for efficient data retrieval.
VPS setup and host frontend and backend applications. And secured with Cloudflare.

projects.name: Faith Journey Bangladesh
projects.subtitle: A single vendor e-commerce platform for cloathing products in Bangladesh.
highlights: Home page builder.
Product & Order management system with real-time updates. And order audit log with user activity tracking.
Various report generation, realtime notification implementation for order processing.
Payment system integration (SSLCommerz).
Data optimization for product listing and search with Redis caching and optimized database queries.

writing.title: Permission Architecture: RBAC in Scalable Systems
writing.summary: Designed and explained scalable role-based access control for SaaS applications — covering structure, trade-offs, and implementation patterns.

writing.title: Async Processing with Queues & Laravel Horizon
writing.summary: Explored queue-based architecture for handling background jobs — improving system performance and reliability in production environments.

writing.title: Load Balancing Strategies for High-Traffic Systems
writing.summary: Analyzed L4/L7 load balancing techniques, algorithms, and scaling patterns — and their role in building resilient distributed systems.

principles.title: Clean architecture
principles.body: Code that other people can read, extend, and trust. Modular boundaries over clever abstractions.

principles.title: Performance as a feature
principles.body: Profile first, optimize what matters. Reduced a 3-second query to 500ms by reading the right indexes, not by adding cache.

principles.title: Ship, then iterate
principles.body: Product-oriented thinking — balance speed, quality, and user impact. Get something real in front of users early.

principles.title: AI as leverage
principles.body: Modern dev workflows treat AI as a power tool — for codegen, review, and exploration — not a replacement for engineering judgment.

education.degree: B.Sc. in Electrical and Electronic Engineering
